lesson: Your company & what it does (B1 · Aula 3)

cards.definition: The main office of a company, where the leadership works.
cards.example:
- Our headquarters is in São Paulo, but I only visit the main office twice a month.
Nossa sede fica em São Paulo, mas eu só visito o escritório principal duas vezes por mês.
cards.note: Sempre com “s” no fim; abrevia-se HQ. A matriz também pode ser head office.

cards.definition: A smaller office or shop of a company in another place.
cards.example:
- We opened a new branch in Recife last year, and it is already profitable.
Abrimos uma filial nova em Recife no ano passado, e ela já dá lucro.
cards.note: Agência de banco também é branch. Não confunda com brunch.

cards.definition: A person who is paid to work for a company.
cards.example:
- The company has about three hundred employees in four different cities.
A empresa tem cerca de trezentos funcionários em quatro cidades diferentes.
cards.note: Employer é o empregador; o conjunto é staff. A sílaba forte fica no fim: employEE.

cards.definition: A person or company that buys your products.
cards.example:
- Our main customers are online stores that sell clothes and accessories.
Nossos principais clientes são lojas online que vendem roupas e acessórios.
cards.note: Cliente de serviços profissionais (advogado, agência) costuma ser client.

cards.definition: To give or supply something that people need.
cards.example:
- We provide software solutions and technical support for clothing brands.
Fornecemos soluções de software e suporte técnico para marcas de roupa.
cards.note: Estruturas: provide something ou provide someone WITH something.

cards.definition: To start a company or an organisation.
cards.example:
- The company was founded in 1998 by two friends from Blumenau.
A empresa foi fundada em 1998 por dois amigos de Blumenau.
cards.note: Passado: founded. Não confunda com found, passado de find (achar).

cards.definition: The company with the biggest share of a market.
cards.example:
- After ten years of hard work, we became the market leader in cotton fabric.
Depois de dez anos de trabalho duro, viramos líderes de mercado em tecido de algodão.
cards.note: Da mesma família: market share (fatia de mercado).

cards.definition: Working and operating normally, after being set up.
cards.example:
- The new factory will be up and running in March, two months ahead of schedule.
A fábrica nova estará funcionando em março, dois meses antes do previsto.
cards.note: Ótima para sistemas e projetos: The website is up and running again.

cards.definition: Cloth, the material used to make clothes.
cards.example:
- We produce high-quality cotton fabric for clothing brands all over Brazil.
Produzimos tecido de algodão de alta qualidade para marcas do Brasil inteiro.
cards.note: “Fábrica” NÃO é fabric — é factory ou plant.

cards.definition: To go to a meeting, class or event.
cards.example:
- I attend meetings with clients twice a week, usually with someone from the design team.
Participo de reuniões com clientes duas vezes por semana, geralmente com alguém do design.
cards.note: “Atender” não é attend: atender o telefone = answer the phone; atender um cliente = help/serve a customer.

exercise.title: Your company & what it does (B1 · Aula 3)

questions.prompt: Our _____ is in São Paulo, but I only visit twice a month.
questions.explanation: The word always ends in “s” and normally takes a singular verb.

questions.prompt: We opened a new _____ in Recife last year.
questions.explanation: A “branch” is a secondary office or shop.

questions.prompt: A person paid to work for the company is an…
questions.explanation: The “employer” is the company; the “employee” is the person.

questions.prompt: Nossos principais clientes são lojas online.
questions.answer: Our main customers are online stores.|Our main customers are online shops.
questions.explanation: “Customer” buys products; “client” pays for a service.

questions.prompt: We _____ clothing brands with software and technical support.
questions.explanation: “Provide someone WITH something”, or “provide something TO someone”.

questions.prompt: Two friends started the company in 1998. The company…
questions.explanation: The company did not found anything — it WAS founded. Passive.

questions.prompt: After ten years, we became the _____ in cotton fabric.
questions.explanation: A fixed pair: the company with the largest market share.

questions.prompt: The new factory will be _____ in March.
You produce cotton material for clothing brands. You produce…
questions.explanation: “Fabric” is cloth. The Portuguese “fábrica” is a “factory”.

questions.prompt: Eu participo de reuniões com clientes duas vezes por semana.
questions.answer: I attend meetings with clients twice a week.|I attend client meetings twice a week.
questions.explanation: “Attend” means to go to. “Assist” means to help.
